From an empty office to Zero Camps.
W latach 2022–2026 fundacja Zero Camps p: Between 2022 and 2026, the Zero Camps foundation helped a total of 3,600 refugees. We provided over 102,000 nights of accommodation, counting each night for each person separately. That is the most important result of our work together.
Pod koniec lutego 2022 roku byłem w Nowy: I was in New York in late February 2022. I was hearing about people fleeing the war in Ukraine and about Poles welcoming them into their homes. I searched online for news using the phrase “Refugees Poland”.
Zapamiętałem z tego momentu materiał Tre: One thing I remember from that moment is a piece by Trevor Noah comparing the reception of people from Ukraine with the situation at the Polish–Belarusian border. I found it superficial and one-sided. I felt that it overlooked both the complex context of that border and the spontaneous help people in Poland were offering.
To moje wspomnienie i mój ówczesny odbió: This is my recollection of the piece and how I saw it at the time, rather than a verbatim account. Above all, I wanted to help people. Poland’s reputation also mattered to me, as did the need to show through action what I saw in the way so many Poles were responding.
Biuro, które mogło się przydać: An office that could be useful
Nasze około 400-metrowe biuro w centrum: Our office in central Kraków, covering roughly 400 square metres, was almost empty because of the pandemic. It had rooms, bathrooms and a kitchen. I suggested to my business partner Adam that we turn it into temporary shelter.
Pracownicy i inne osoby przynosili wypos: Employees and other people brought equipment, helped prepare the rooms and organised what was needed. We bought food. In about two days, we had room for 22 people.
Niedługo później wróciłem do Polski i za: Not long afterwards, I returned to Poland and began helping on the ground. I went to the railway station and let volunteers know that we had space for people who needed somewhere to stay.
Apel i odpowiedź przyjaciela: An appeal and a friend’s response
Opublikowałem zdjęcie pokazujące, jak wy: I posted a photo showing how we were using the office and appealed to other business owners to make their empty spaces available. The amount of individual help was enormous, but we also needed places that could accommodate more people.
Odpowiedział Hewitt Strange, mój dawny p: Hewitt Strange, an old friend I had once lived with, responded. He wanted to get involved and, together with partners from organisations in the US, could provide funding to work on a larger scale.
Hewitt przyjechał do Krakowa. Przez pona: Hewitt came to Kraków. He stayed with me for over a month, sleeping on the sofa. Together, we worked out a plan and organised more places to stay.
Od doraźnej pomocy do zespołu: From immediate help to a team
Znalazłem dwa hostele do wynajęcia. Po u: I found two hostels to rent. After agreeing the terms, we accommodated a total of 90 people there. We were also given the use of flats on Lea Street in Kraków, free of charge.
Zaczęliśmy budować stały zespół. Dołączy: We began building a permanent team. One person I had met at the railway station during the evacuation of her ill father joined us, followed by Olena, who responded to an advert. Hewitt, the team and I continued the work over the following years.
Tak powstało Zero Camps. Gdy codzienne f: That is how Zero Camps began. Once the day-to-day running of the accommodation had settled down, we began looking for ways to make the foundation more financially independent. Ciepło grew out of that search.
Ciepło began in a shared kitchen.
W latach 2022–2026 kluczową rolę w opiec: Between 2022 and 2026, Marina played a key role in caring for the people supported by the foundation.
